answer: The design leans on sharding with cross-shard communication protocols. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A willow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the juniper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
